subject: Private CP identity cutover: entitlement-lattice & SAML/SCIM mapping
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@horizonpayments.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: it-security@horizonpayments.com
Date: 2025-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private CP: SAML/SCIM integration for VPC deployment

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the demo this week. We are lining up the security and ops owners to start our private control plane onboarding. Two asks up front: 1) a checklist (SAML/metadata, SCIM provisioning mappings, role names) that we can give to our IdP team, and 2) a recommended cutover approach — we want minimal downtime and a clear rollback.

Specifics: our IdP team uses Okta and they prefer attribute-based role mapping (we currently have roles: Ops, PlatformAdmin, AppSupport, ReadOnly). We also have a separate HR source of truth for group membership that we'd like to sync to Redwood via SCIM.

Can you share the expected attribute names (NameID vs email), the preferred SCIM group schema, and any network egress/allowlist requirements for the VPC connector?

-Daniel
IT Security Lead, Horizon Payments

-----Original Message-----
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel@horizonpayments.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: SAML/SCIM integration for VPC deployment

Thanks Daniel — really helpful context. Attaching a pragmatic checklist (saml-scim-checklist-v1.pdf) and a draft entitlement lattice workbook that shows how we suggest mapping Okta groups -> Redwood roles. High level plan below:  

- Phase 0: Discovery (today) — confirm attribute names, IdP metadata, and SCIM provisioning URI + token policy.
- Phase 1: Non-prod integration — wire SAML SP in staging CP, test SCIM group sync (one test group).
- Phase 2: Role-hierarchy mapping & pilot — deploy entitlement-lattice mapping in a canary tenant for 2 dev teams.
- Phase 3: Production cutover — short freeze window, validate login & SCIM sync, monitor audit logs for 24hrs, rollback to IdP-only (disable provisioning) if any regressions.

Notes on attributes we prefer: NameID as persistent subject (okta.persistentId) or email; we accept email but prefer persistent ID for user key stability. For SCIM groups we recommend using 'displayName' + 'members[].value' = Okta user GUIDs and include 'externalId' for your HR id. See attached spreadsheet for the role naming conventions (entitlement-lattice-mapping.xlsx).

Network egress: the VPC connector needs outbound-only HTTPS to the control plane endpoints and to our SCIM endpoint. I attached a simple network-egress-diagram.png. Full IP ranges and TLS cert thumbprints are in the checklist doc.

Jordan, Laura, Marissa — can you help with the proposed attribute contract? Jordan: can you outline the SCIM delta handling (add/replace/remove) and concurrency concerns? Marissa: we should capture the cutover runbook and the freeze window timing.

-Chloe
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-20T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: SAML/SCIM integration for VPC deployment

Chloe — quick technical hit list below that we can share with Horizon. I added a few pragmatic guardrails and the Jira we should track: INF-1123.

- SCIM semantics: support PATCH (RFC 7644) for partial updates; treat group membership as authoritative only when 'externalId' present to avoid stomping on manually-created groups.
- Provisioning cadence: start at 1-minute push in staging, ramp to 5-minute in pilot, 15-minute in prod for first 24h then 60-minute steady-state.
- Conflict resolution: when userGUID matches but email differs, prefer identity by persistent OKTA GUID; log an event to audit and alert CS if >1% mismatch during sync window.
- Role mapping engine: we model an 'entitlement lattice' (spreadsheet attached) — supports union of group memberships to compute derived roles. We'll implement canary toggle: evaluate mapping but do not enforce until validation flag flips.
- SCIM rate limits & backoff: exponential backoff with jitter; bulk PATCH support for groups up to 200 members.

Marissa — recommend a 2-hour production freeze window during weekday early morning (02:00–04:00 local) for the cutover; include a pre-check list (connectivity, token validity, audit sampling). Also add a quick rollback step: disable provisioning and revert SAML SP metadata to previous endpoint.

I'll draft the detailed delta handling notes and add them to INF-1123. Also linking the DocuSign DPA we need signed before production: https://app.docusign.com/rsign/XXX-privcp-dpa

—Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
From: Daniel Park <daniel@horizonpayments.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: it-security@horizonpayments.com
Date: 2025-07-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: SAML/SCIM integration for VPC deployment

Chloe/Jordan/Marissa — thanks for the rapid response and the attachments. A few clarifications from our IdP team (copied):

- We'll provide Okta SP metadata by EOD Monday and we will use persistent OKTA GUIDs for NameID.
- Our HR system uses 'employeeId' as the authoritative externalId; we'll include that in SCIM groups.
- The 02:00–04:00 window works for us on August 6th; please schedule the change and the post-cutover 24h monitoring with your CS contact.

One operational ask: during the pilot can we keep a read-only fallback (disable role enforcement) so our dev teams can still log in even if mapping misfires?

Also attaching a short dump of our current role -> group matrix for reference (attached offline to security channel). We'll sign the DPA and route the DocuSign link this week.

Thanks — Daniel
IT Security Lead, Horizon Payments
